craft_notes: Sthāyin: expansion (restraint makes room). Sanskrit: bhāve tyakte...vikasatyati bhāvanā → L4 keeps abandonment then expansion. Rows: row 2 (restrained→expands exceedingly). Close: exceedingly (the intensifier carried — adhika-sṛṣṭi register). Rejected: 'dissolves' — NO: vikasati is EXPANDING (opposite of dissolve — kept); 'meditation deepens' — killed: expands kept.

lines: State abandoned, restrained consciousness goes no-where-else:
then in that middle-being — contemplation expands exceedingly.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhāve tyakte niruddhā cin naiva bhāvāntaraṃ vrajet | tadā tanmadhyabhāvena vikasatyati bhāvanā

reads_against.argmap: What expands in the middle? → Restrained from all other states, contemplation expands exceedingly in the middle.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta charged with vīra (wonder armed with intensity)
